answer: In an agent economy trading shale, canyon tour bookings, and velvet, each agent must lock collateral for 30 days to vote on marketplace disputes. Voting weight equals locked collateral, and the same deposit cannot back multiple identities. Splitting $1,000 among a thousand agents therefore buys no more influence than putting it behind one. An attacker seeking majority control must lock more capital than all honest voters combined, tying up funds for the full period.
